title: Noor and the Harvest
author: Casper Okonkwo
blurb: Ivo Reyes, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
